webster.text: To misunderstand; to take in a wrong sense.

example.quote: But the position has been misapprehended ; and its application is entirely false and unwarrantable : it relates onlv to democracies, where the whole body of the people meet to transact business, and where representation is unknown.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 27, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
